name: neutrophil_to_lymphocyte_ratio
reason: The explicitly reported or CBC-derived ratio directly captures the repeatedly supported leukocyte balance.

name: white_blood_cell_count
reason: Total white blood cell count captures absolute leukocyte abundance, which the ratio does not, and has its own adjusted signal.

name: creatinine_clearance
reason: Pretreatment creatinine clearance is a specified filtration measurement with repeated forest support and avoids the naming ambiguity of feature 033.

name: blood_urea_nitrogen
reason: BUN provides a distinct nitrogen-burden measurement with repeated forest support and some univariable and R-learner support.

name: dyspnea_severity
reason: The specified patient-reported 0–4 grade is the precise measurement carrying the recurring adjusted signal.

name: ck5_6_expression
reason: CK5/6 directly measures the squamous-lineage facet and has recurring own-feature evidence.

name: ttf1_expression
reason: TTF-1 supplies a complementary glandular-lineage facet with recurring own-feature evidence; adding Napsin A would be more redundant.

name: kras_g12c_variant_allele_frequency
reason: It retains the mutation-specific meaning of the recurring signal; generic VAF could refer to another variant.

name: met_amplification_status
reason: It directly identifies MET amplification and has its own recurring adjusted evidence.

name: ki67_proliferation_index
reason: It is the existing quantitative proliferation measurement carrying the recurring signal.

name: prior_platinum_chemotherapy
reason: It directly specifies platinum exposure before the current treatment context; the agent-specific proxies reinforce this history but have less secure timing or narrower coverage.

name: emphysema
reason: Documented emphysema is the facet with the clearest repeated own-feature adjusted evidence.

name: dizziness_present
reason: Dizziness is a specific pretreatment symptom with the most complementary evidence in this concept.

name: liver_metastasis_presence
reason: It directly records pretreatment liver metastatic involvement and has its own cross-fold evidence.
